R44AV.name: UNIVERSAL_EXACT_SAFE_BRANCH_CHOICE_CHARACTERIZATION
R44AV.theorem: A deterministic polynomial-time chooser C(F,v) that always returns epsilon with SAT(F) iff SAT(F[v=epsilon]) exists iff P=NP.
R44AV.effect: Universal exact single-branch choice is the final frontier, not a smaller lemma. Partial certified safe-choice primitives remain admissible only with explicit scope.

R44AW.name: SIGN_FLIP_TRANSLATION_SYMMETRY_QUOTIENT_INVARIANT
R44AW.invariant: H(F)<=GF(2)^n, the subgroup of variable sign-flip masks preserving the clause multiset.
R44AW.polytime_computation: For width<=3, compute local sign-pattern translation stabilizers on each variable support (at most 8 masks), convert to linear constraints, and intersect by Gaussian elimination.
R44AW.exact_descent: If rank H(F)=r>0, row-echelon pivots can all be fixed to 0 satisfiability-equivalently; every model can be xor-shifted by a formula symmetry to satisfy those pivot assignments.
R44AW.obstruction: Arbitrarily large exact-width-3 SAT and UNSAT families with H(F)={0} are explicitly constructed, so the invariant is not universal.

next_frontier: Search for another polynomially computable exact quotient/descent invariant that acts on the symmetry-rigid exact-3CNF core H(F)={0}, without reverting to Davis-Putnam, proof-search, or hidden terminal SAT evaluation.
